startMessage.line1: Which of your partner's moves shakes you the most?
startMessage.line2: One read receipt. One like from a stranger. Your chest drops for a second. Anxiety buttons sit in different places for everyone—but when they get pressed, we all wobble. Know yours, and you can speak before you spiral.
startMessage.line3: In twelve scenes, pick the side that shakes you more. We'll rank your top 3 anxiety buttons. Light self-check when counseling feels like too much.
startMessage.line5: Find my anxiety buttons 🔵 Start honest
startMessage.note: ※ Pick the option that would shake you more. If you're single, use your most recent relationship.
